summary: Verified AI chat fix (GEMINI_API_KEY added to /app/backend/.env). Backend POST /api/chat returns HTTP 200 with valid Azerbaijani replies for single-turn and multi-turn requests. Frontend AI chat widget opens from launcher, sends messages, renders assistant replies and product recommendation cards. Multi-turn history is respected (follow-up 'qadin ucun modeller?' correctly returned women's watches). All 3 scenarios in the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1814 lines — should be split into routers (chat, epoint, admin, auth) for maintainability.

ChatResponse only returns 'reply' text; product recommendations rely on the frontend regex-extracting product IDs from LLM text — brittle. Consider structured output (products: [ids]) from the LLM to make product cards deterministic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI chat verified working end-to-end via preview URL. Backend .env has GEMINI_API_KEY + GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-flash-lite-latest. Widget test-ids: ai-chat-launcher, ai-chat-input, ai-chat-send, ai-chat-msg-assistant-*, ai-product-card-*.
rca of the issue: Original bug: /app/backend/.env missing => GEMINI_API_KEY empty => /api/chat threw 500. Fix (already applied by E1 before this run) was to create backend/.env with a valid GEMINI_API_KEY and model. Verified by direct curl (200 + reply) and by UI end-to-end test through the external preview URL.
